glossary.definition: A temporary collection of products that a customer intends to purchase
The process of finalizing a purchase by providing delivery and payment information
A specific time window during which an order will be delivered
A user with the role of delivering flower orders to customers
An optional personalized message that accompanies a flower delivery
The current state of an order in the fulfillment process (pending, confirmed, processing, out for delivery, delivered, cancelled)
A third-party service that processes credit card and other payment transactions securely
A flower arrangement or bouquet available for purchase in the catalog
Customer feedback including a rating and optional comment about a purchased product
The number of units of a product currently available for sale
The process of replacing sensitive payment card data with a non-sensitive equivalent for secure storage
The type of user account (customer, driver, or admin) that determines access permissions
A classification grouping for flower products (e.g., roses, mixed bouquets, occasions)
User settings that control which types of notifications they receive and through which channels
The mean of all customer ratings for a specific product
